Class ObservableTribeModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.ObservableGame.ObservableTribeModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
DTOUpdatable<TribeDTO>
public class ObservableTribeModel extends Object implements DTOUpdatable<TribeDTO>
Observable model representing a player's tribe for the JavaFX GUI layer. Holds the tribe's character cards and building cards as observable lists, updating them only when their content actually changes to avoid unnecessary UI refresh events.

      public void updateFromDTO(TribeDTO dto)
      Updates this tribe model from the provided TribeDTO. Each list is updated only if its content differs from the DTO, avoiding unnecessary change events on the UI.
      Specified by:
      updateFromDTO in interface DTOUpdatable<TribeDTO>
